Settings.ShowRulesCompendiumHint: Shows the internal Rules Compendium in the Compendium Browser. The Rule system works regardless of this setting.
Settings.ExperimentalMarkerRendererHint: Enables the experimental marker graphics in FFXIVActor embeds. Centered and Adjacent markers are supported; line markers remain excluded.
Settings.ExperimentalPagePointerHint: Enables the experimental pointer for the active Journal page. When multiple Journals are open, it is shown only in the front-most window.
Settings.ExperimentalPageChangeSoundHint: Plays the FFXIV confirmation sound when switching to another Journal page from the table of contents.
Settings.ExperimentalPageChangeSoundVolumeHint: Sets the FFXIV confirmation sound volume (0–100%).
Settings.PaperThemeHint: Overrides core settings light/dark color scheme with a paper theme, inspired by the FFXIV TTRPG Rulebook. Does not work with the Blue Color Theme.
Settings.ChatCardsHint: Shows Ability and Trait chat messages with the module's FFXIV Card instead of the system card. The buttons stay as they are.
